description: UK dates for disagreeing with HMRC: appeal or ask for a review usually within 30 days of the decision letter (then 30 days after a review to accept or go to the tribunal), and overpayment relief claims within 4 years after the end of the tax year (TMA 1970 Sch 1AB para 3). United Kingdom, as of 2026-11-21 (gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk). Income Tax bands are for England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scottish bands are not calculated. General information and estimates only; not personal tax advice, no agent services and no filing with HMRC.
